title: ARCHITECTURAL: API keys loaded into renderer memory — replace with boolean hasKey
description:
CRITICAL: All 13 provider API keys are loaded into the renderer's Zustand store on every `loadSettings()` call via `STORE_GET_API_KEY` IPC channel. Even though keys aren't passed in the generate flow, they persist in renderer heap for the entire session.

Fix architecture:
1. Add `STORE_HAS_API_KEY(service)` → boolean IPC channel (returns whether key exists without revealing the key)
2. Change `settings-store.ts` to store `hasApiKeys: Record<string, boolean>` instead of `providerApiKeys: Record<string, string>`
3. Update ProviderConfigCard to use `hasApiKeys` for display (masked status)
4. Keep `STORE_SAVE_API_KEY` channel (renderer → main) for saving keys
5. Remove `STORE_GET_API_KEY` channel entirely
6. Remove `getActiveLLMConfig()` from store (dead code, returns the active key)

Risk: Without this fix, any XSS or compromised devtools can exfiltrate all 13 API keys.
resolution: Architectural fix applied: replaced STORE_GET_API_KEY with STORE_HAS_API_KEY (boolean). Renderer no longer receives decrypted API keys. provider-api-keys map changed to has-api-keys (boolean only). getActiveLLMConfig removed. Keys are only accessed in main process via safeStorage.
